lines: I wonder if I don't fit into your everyday life
Snow fell from a white sky
The sigh I let out, saying it doesn't matter
Lingered a little, then faded away looking lonely
I wonder if it's falling in your city too
Ah, right here beside me now
When it comes to smiling and saying the snow is beautiful, I want it to be you
But the way you look happy saying it's cold
And the way you laugh saying thank you, just past the hand you grabbed when you nearly fell
The way you look happy saying thank you, just past the hand you grabbed when you nearly fell
That too, I want it to be you
Before I knew it, everything around was dyed almost entirely white
I almost forget how much of a mess it was
I went to send a text saying it's piled up more than expected
But left it half-written and put it in my pocket
Someone strong and kind, the kind people fall for
I wonder if I could ever become that
When it comes to smiling and saying the snow is beautiful, I want it to be you
The answer I started to give aches in my chest
Not knowing how to hand it over, or where I should throw it away
The scenery you see from where you stand
I'm simply afraid of it
Come to think of it, whatever movie I watched
Whatever novel or music
It's always you I end up casting as the heroine
Distant places I want to visit, night skies I want to see
I always picture you beside me in them
This town I should know so well, and yet
I'm such a fool
When white snow fell in your city
Who did you want to see?
Who did you want to tell the snow is beautiful?
I knew it, I—
When it comes to smiling and saying the snow is beautiful, I want it to be you
But the way you look happy saying it's cold
And the way you laugh saying thank you, just past the hand you grabbed when you nearly fell
The way you look happy saying thank you, just past the hand you grabbed when you nearly fell
All of it, I want it to be you
